attributes.name: photography_subject_style
attributes.definition: The kind of subject matter and shooting style of photographs on the page.

values.definition: Real people in candid, everyday or workplace scenes.
Staged or styled lifestyle scenes, often contrasted with product shots.
Clean studio or rendered product imagery.
Other subject matter or no photography.

attributes.name: photography_crop_consistency
attributes.definition: Whether photographs are cropped to uniform aspect ratios or sizes.

values.definition: Images share the same aspect ratio or size within a group.
Images use differing aspect ratios or sizes.

attributes.name: photography_color_treatment
attributes.definition: Whether photographs are color-graded or styled to match the site's palette.

values.definition: Photos are tinted or styled to match the brand palette.
